tickets.title: Ticket #10421 - Standard Refund Window Eligibility
tickets.content: Customer requested full refund on day 11 following initial purchase of annual license. Agent confirmed compliance with 14-day policy window and issued $1,200 refund to original payment card.
tickets.author: Support Agent Maria K.

tickets.title: Ticket #10488 - Refund Request Rejected on Day 16
tickets.content: Customer submitted refund request on day 16 post-purchase. Policy strictly limits standard refunds to 14 calendar days. Request rejected per Billing Policy v3.0 section 4; customer offered technical onboarding session instead.
tickets.author: Support Agent Sarah T.

tickets.title: Ticket #10530 - Enterprise 30-Day Evaluation Refund Exception
tickets.content: Enterprise client Apex Global requested evaluation refund on day 24. While consumer portal lists 14 days, client MSA contract includes 30-day proof-of-concept clause. Exception approved under Enterprise Policy Addendum.
tickets.author: Senior Escalations Agent Mike D.

tickets.title: Ticket #10612 - Mid-Term Pro-Rated Subscription Refund Denied
tickets.content: Customer requested pro-rated refund 6 months into their annual subscription after moving companies. Explained that annual plans are discounted upfront and non-refundable beyond the initial 14-day window. Account set to cancel at end of term.
tickets.author: Support Agent Maria K.

tickets.title: Ticket #10675 - Subscription Cancellation Timing Clarification
tickets.content: Inquiry regarding cancellation timeline. When a user clicks 'Cancel Subscription', access remains active until the end of the current paid billing cycle. No immediate account termination occurs unless requested explicitly for security compliance.
tickets.author: Support Agent Chen W.

tickets.title: Ticket #10720 - Failed Payment Grace Period and Lockout
tickets.content: Customer credit card expired causing recurring payment failure. System initiated 72-hour grace period with automated retry at 24h, 48h, and 72h marks. Customer updated card details within 48h, preventing automated account suspension.
tickets.author: Support Agent Sarah T.

tickets.title: Ticket #10781 - Duplicate Charge Discrepancy via Stripe Webhook
tickets.content: Client reported two $450 charges on Feb 26. Investigation revealed duplicate charge event dispatched during Stripe webhook gateway migration. Second transaction was voided and refunded within 2 hours.
tickets.author: Billing Specialist Elena R.

tickets.title: Ticket #10840 - International Currency Conversion Discrepancy
tickets.content: Customer billed in GBP noticed slight variance from USD pricing table. Clarified that international billing utilizes daily spot exchange rates plus local statutory VAT (20% for UK). Tax breakdown was provided to customer.
tickets.author: Support Agent Chen W.

tickets.title: Ticket #9842 - 2024 SLA Outage Credit Claim
tickets.content: Customer submitted formal claim for 10% credit following US-East downtime in November 2024. Under 2024 SLA agreement, uptime dropped to 99.7% (below 99.9% guarantee). Manual claim verified and 10% invoice credit granted.
tickets.author: Operations Liaison Dan P.

tickets.title: Ticket #10915 - Automatic 15% Outage Credit Under 2025 SLA
tickets.content: Customer inquired why their February invoice showed an unrequested 15% discount. Confirmed that under the revised 2025 SLA policy, monthly uptime of 99.88% breached the 99.95% target, triggering an automatic 15% credit without manual filing.
tickets.author: Senior Escalations Agent Mike D.

tickets.title: Ticket #10960 - Scheduled Maintenance Excluded from SLA Uptime
tickets.content: Client contested 45 minutes of scheduled maintenance on Sunday 02:00 UTC as an SLA breach. Pointed out Section 3.2 of Master Services Agreement: scheduled maintenance windows announced 5 business days in advance are excluded from downtime calculations.
tickets.author: Operations Liaison Dan P.

tickets.title: Ticket #11005 - Multi-Region High Availability SLA Guarantee
tickets.content: Enterprise Tier-1 contract inquiry regarding multi-region active-active deployments. Service contract specifies 99.99% uptime for multi-region configurations, backed by a 25% credit if regional failover exceeds 120 seconds.
tickets.author: Solutions Architect Vikram S.

tickets.title: Ticket #11050 - Missing CSV Export Option in Analytics UI
tickets.content: User reported that the 'Export to CSV' button vanished from the analytics dashboard after the weekend deploy. Advised user that CSV export was deprecated and permanently removed in release v2.4 due to spreadsheet macro injection vulnerabilities.
tickets.author: Support Agent Sarah T.

tickets.title: Ticket #11082 - Guidance for Alternative Data Export (JSON & Parquet)
tickets.content: Following CSV export removal, client data team asked for programmatic export guidance. Provided API documentation for /api/v2/export endpoint which streams newline-delimited JSON or Apache Parquet formats with SHA256 checksums.
tickets.author: Technical Support Engineer Alex B.

tickets.title: Ticket #11120 - Request for Legacy CSV Export Override Denied
tickets.content: Customer requested a temporary tenant flag to re-enable CSV export for legacy downstream ETL pipelines. Security team denied the request; corporate policy prohibits unescaped CSV serialization across all production clusters.
tickets.author: Senior Escalations Agent Mike D.

tickets.title: Ticket #11175 - Kafka Cluster High Availability Sizing Rules
tickets.content: Client configuring dedicated message broker requested cluster sizing guidelines. Confirmed architecture requirement: Kafka clusters must be provisioned with at least 3 broker nodes across distinct AZs with replication factor 3 and min.insync.replicas=2.
tickets.author: Solutions Architect Vikram S.

tickets.title: Ticket #11210 - SQLite Database Lock Contention in High-Concurrency Worker
tickets.content: Client self-hosting local worker nodes encountered 'database is locked' errors. Advised enabling WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) mode via PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL and setting busy_timeout to 5000ms in connection pool configuration.
tickets.author: Technical Support Engineer Alex B.

tickets.title: Ticket #11265 - REST API Rate Limit Thresholds and Headers
tickets.content: Developer inquiry regarding 429 Too Many Requests response codes. Standard tier API rate limit is 1,000 requests per minute; Enterprise tier accommodates up to 5,000 requests per minute. Rate limit status is returned in X-RateLimit-Remaining headers.
tickets.author: Technical Support Engineer Alex B.

tickets.title: Ticket #11302 - Outbound Webhook Delivery Retry Policy
tickets.content: Customer asked about dropped webhook delivery guarantees. EvidenRoute retries failed webhook deliveries up to 5 times using exponential backoff (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 6h) over a 24-hour window before tagging endpoint as unhealthy.
tickets.author: Support Agent Chen W.

tickets.title: Ticket #11350 - Unidentified Third-Party Quantum Adapter Failure
tickets.content: Customer submitted ticket inquiring why their third-party quantum entanglement connector module failed to initialize. Agent noted that no such quantum adapter or driver exists in EvidenRoute product catalog; recommended consulting external vendor.
tickets.author: Support Agent Maria K.

conversations.title: #billing-ops: Enterprise 30-Day Evaluation Refund Procedure
conversations.content: Dave (Billing Dev): Quick note for support: if an Enterprise account on an MSA asks for a refund within 30 days, do NOT auto-reject under the 14-day rule. Enterprise sales contracts include a 30-day evaluation rider managed in Salesforce. Route to escalations.
conversations.author: Dave (Billing Dev)

conversations.title: #billing-general: Annual Subscription Pro-Rating Clarification
conversations.content: Elena (Billing Lead): We are getting questions about mid-term cancellations. Per executive policy, annual subscriptions are sold at a 20% discount upfront and cannot be pro-rated or refunded after day 14. Cancellation simply stops auto-renewal at end of period.
conversations.author: Elena (Billing Lead)

conversations.title: #engineering: Stripe Webhook Duplicate Charge Incident
conversations.content: Marcus (Platform Eng): Heads up team, during yesterday's Stripe webhook migration, an idempotency key misconfiguration caused roughly 18 accounts to be charged twice. Billing ops has voided all duplicate authorizations. Idempotency layer is now patched.
conversations.author: Marcus (Platform Eng)

conversations.title: #ops-incidents: 2025 SLA Automatic Credit Implementation
conversations.content: Dan (SRE Lead): Team, reminder that starting Jan 1 2025, our SLA credit calculation changed. Under the 2024 SLA, customers had to manually open a ticket within 30 days for a 10% credit. In 2025 SLA revision, if monthly uptime drops below 99.95%, our billing pipeline automatically applies 15% credit.
conversations.author: Dan (SRE Lead)

conversations.title: #product-discussions: 2024 vs 2025 SLA Grandfathering Policy
conversations.content: Sarah (Support Lead): What happens to enterprise contracts signed before 2025? Dan (SRE): Contracts signed prior to Jan 1 2025 follow their signed 2024 SLA terms (99.9% uptime, 10% credit upon manual claim) until renewal. All new 2025 contracts get 99.95% / 15% auto.
conversations.author: Dan (SRE Lead)

conversations.title: #announcements: Release v2.4 Security Notice - CSV Export Removal
conversations.content: VP Engineering: Release v2.4 is deployed to production. Notice: CSV export has been permanently removed due to CSV injection vulnerabilities (formula execution in Microsoft Excel). Only JSON and Parquet formats are supported moving forward.
conversations.author: VP Engineering

conversations.title: #support-internal: Workaround for Clients Demanding CSV Data
conversations.content: Alex (Tech Support): For clients whose accounting software still demands CSV, share the snippet from docs/scripts/json_to_csv_converter.py. They can export JSON via API and run the python script locally on their trusted machine.
conversations.author: Alex (Tech Support)

conversations.title: #billing-ops: Dunning and Payment Failure Grace Period
conversations.content: Elena (Billing Lead): When a card fails on subscription renewal, the account does NOT lock immediately. We grant a 72-hour grace period with retries at 24h, 48h, and 72h. If unresolved at 72 hours, account is downgraded to read-only.
conversations.author: Elena (Billing Lead)

conversations.title: #infra-architecture: Kafka Sizing Constraints for Self-Hosted Deployments
conversations.content: Vikram (Architect): Critical reminder for enterprise architects: Kafka clusters deployed on-premise must have minimum 3 brokers in distinct availability zones. Running 2 brokers causes quorum lock during single-node restarts.
conversations.author: Vikram (Architect)

conversations.title: #backend-dev: SQLite Search Index Maintenance Schedule
conversations.content: Priya (DBA): The SQLite FTS5 search index rebuild task runs nightly at 02:00 UTC via cron. If queries appear to lag behind newly ingested records by a few seconds, that is normal debounce buffering.
conversations.author: Priya (DBA)

conversations.title: #api-guild: API Rate Limiting Quotas and Tier Headers
conversations.content: Alex (Tech Support): Standard tier is capped at 1,000 req/min, while Enterprise tier gets 5,000 req/min. Both return X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining HTTP response headers.
conversations.author: Alex (Tech Support)

conversations.title: #watercooler: False Rumor Regarding CSV Export Return
conversations.content: Junior Dev: Hey, I heard someone say CSV export is coming back in release v2.6 with sanitization? VP Engineering: Absolutely not true. That rumor was debunked in security council. CSV is deprecated permanently. Do not tell clients otherwise.
conversations.author: VP Engineering

conversations.title: #security-ops: Okta & Azure AD SAML 2.0 Integration Support
conversations.content: Sarah (Support Lead): Customer is asking if we support Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta SAML 2.0 SSO. Yes, both are fully supported on Enterprise tier. ACS URL and Entity ID are available in the Security Settings tab.
conversations.author: Sarah (Support Lead)

conversations.title: #billing-ops: Currency Precision Edge Case for Indian Rupee (INR)
conversations.content: Elena (Billing Lead): Edge case note: When processing INR transactions, ensure razorpay webhook handles paise without sub-unit truncation. We had a 2-paise rounding discrepancy reported on Ticket #10840.
conversations.author: Elena (Billing Lead)

conversations.title: #research-speculation: Quantum Key Distribution Exploration (Future)
conversations.content: Research Scientist Leo: Wondering if our roadmap will ever explore quantum key distribution or post-quantum lattice cryptography? VP Engineering: Not in our 2025 or 2026 roadmap. There are zero production features or plugins for quantum encryption.
conversations.author: VP Engineering

benchmarks.question: What are the sizing rules and broker count for deploying a Kafka cluster?
benchmarks.expected_answer: Kafka clusters must be provisioned with at least 3 broker nodes across distinct availability zones with replication factor 3 and min.insync.replicas=2 to avoid quorum locks.

benchmarks.question: How long is the standard refund window for a new software license?
benchmarks.expected_answer: All standard software license subscriptions are eligible for a 100% refund within 14 calendar days of initial purchase. Beyond 14 days, standard refunds are not granted.

benchmarks.question: What is the outage credit percentage under the current 2025 SLA policy?
benchmarks.expected_answer: Under the 2025 SLA revision, if monthly uptime drops below 99.95%, an automatic 15% billing credit is applied without requiring a manual claim.

benchmarks.question: Does EvidenRoute support CSV export from the analytics dashboard?
benchmarks.expected_answer: CSV export was deprecated and permanently removed in release v2.4 due to spreadsheet formula injection vulnerabilities. Programmatic exports are supported via JSON and Parquet.

benchmarks.question: How does the 2024 SLA outage credit differ from the 2025 SLA revision?
benchmarks.expected_answer: The 2024 SLA guaranteed 99.9% uptime with a 10% credit upon manual claim within 30 days, whereas the 2025 SLA guarantees 99.95% uptime with an automatic 15% credit.

benchmarks.question: What happens if a recurring credit card payment fails on renewal?
benchmarks.expected_answer: The system grants a 72-hour grace period with automated retries at 24h, 48h, and 72h. If unresolved after 72 hours, the account is downgraded to read-only.

benchmarks.question: How do quantum hyperspace engines calibrate on Mars?
What are the configuration parameters for quantum key distribution in EvidenRoute?
Can enterprise clients get an evaluation refund beyond the standard 14 days?
benchmarks.expected_answer: Yes, enterprise accounts with an executed Master Services Agreement (MSA) have a 30-day proof-of-concept evaluation refund rider managed in Salesforce.

benchmarks.question: Will CSV export feature be reinstated in release v2.6?
benchmarks.expected_answer: No. Rumors of CSV export returning in v2.6 have been explicitly debunked by engineering leadership; CSV export remains permanently deprecated.

benchmarks.question: Can customers obtain a pro-rated refund on mid-term annual subscription cancellation?
benchmarks.expected_answer: No, annual plans receive an upfront 20% discount and are non-refundable beyond the initial 14-day window. Cancellation stops auto-renewal at the end of the term.

benchmarks.question: What are the API rate limit quotas for standard and enterprise developer tiers?
benchmarks.expected_answer: Standard tier is limited to 1,000 requests per minute, while Enterprise tier allows up to 5,000 requests per minute, with headers X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining provided.

benchmarks.question: What identity providers are supported for SAML 2.0 single sign-on?
benchmarks.expected_answer: Both Okta and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) are supported for SAML 2.0 SSO on the Enterprise tier.

benchmarks.question: What is the outbound webhook retry policy for failed delivery endpoints?
benchmarks.expected_answer: EvidenRoute retries failed webhook deliveries up to 5 times using exponential backoff (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 6h) over a 24-hour window.
